def factor_volume_intensity_streak_avg(df):
    """
    Average excess volume during high-volume streaks, normalizing for streak length.
    """
    df_copy = df.copy()
    vol_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(50, min_periods=1).mean()
    vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / vol_ma
    high_vol = vol_ratio > 1.5
    excess = (vol_ratio - 1.0).where(high_vol, 0.0)
    group = (high_vol != high_vol.shift(1)).cumsum()
    streak_excess = excess.groupby(group).cumsum()
    streak_count = high_vol.groupby(group).cumsum()
    avg_excess = (streak_excess / streak_count.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_intensity_streak_avg"] = avg_excess
    return df_copy["factor_volume_intensity_streak_avg"]
description: Mutates the parent volume intensity streak factor by taking the running average excess volume per day within each streak instead of the cumulative sum. This normalization removes the streak-length bias, making the signal more stationary and comparable across stocks, which should improve linear correlation (IC) and stability (ICIR) while preserving the core mechanism of capturing volume intensity persistence.
